result.brief: 提出紧凑 Delta 潜变量作为可操作世界状态转移接口，用局部转移滤波与全局锚点统一学习，并驱动动作去噪，替代完整未来预测。
result.reason: Proposes compact latent "Delta" world-state transition representation as interface between VLM understanding and action generation, replacing full future-state prediction; a representation-level world-model contribution.
